message:
Running command: python3 -c "
# TGA header
header = bytearray(18)
header[0] = 0    # id_length
header[1] = 0    # colormap_type
header[2] = 10   # image_type = RLE RGB
header[12] = 1   # width = 1
header[14] = 1   # height = 1
header[16] = 16  # pixel_size = 16
header[17] = 0   # flags

# RLE data: RLE packet header 0x80 (count=1), then NO pixel data (need 2 bytes)
data = bytes(header) + bytes([0x80])

with open('/workspace/poc3.tga', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
print('Wrote', len(data), 'bytes')
print(data.hex())
"
